The '''Port Landien Perfumery''' was a [[Perfume/Legends|perfume]] store in [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Port Landien]]. In [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] apprehended the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] criminal [[Kroke Modbom]] here.<ref name="The Monster">{{GamerCite|2|The Monster}}''</ref>
